the coupled field-circuit model of DFIG can provide a good insight into its transient behavior.
the finite element model can accurately predict the transient behavior of DFIG, while the analytical model can be used for fast simulation of the DFIG behavior in transient conditions.

the transient analysis of DFIG using the finite element coupled circuit model can provide more accurate results than the conventional lumped parameter-based analytical model.
